name: ArenaTableCellLayout
description: How an ArenaTable column's cells render in card mode. `row` is a label/value pair. `block` is a full-width strip with no label, and its contents sit at the end of it. That shape is the one an actions cell wants. A long value takes `row` or a cell of its own. Set to `block`, a long value draws with the whole gap on its leading side. Checked against every enum already declared here; nothing carries this pair. The `arena-skeleton-block` shape class is the only other declaration containing the word `block`, and it names a shape of placeholder rather than a layout.
